Name: Rainbow Trail
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
With this mod, pressing a hotkey (default [b]NumPad 1[/b]) toggles a rainbow trail that follows your farmer.

[youtube]15ODPphvGnc[/youtube]

You can customize the length of the trail in the config.

By default, the trail gives a speed buff, you can disable this in the config by setting it to 0.

You can use Content Patcher to create a mod that replaces the rainbow colours with any 64x64 graphic you want (see this mod's [b]assets/rainbow.png[/b] as a template). The target path is [b]"aedenthorn.RainbowTrail"[/b].

E.g.:

[code]﻿{
    "Format": "1.23.0",
    "Changes": [
        {
            "Action": "Load",
            "Target": "aedenthorn.RainbowTrail",
            "FromFile": "assets/rainbow.png"
        }
    ]
}
[/code]

An example of this is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16919]Void's RainbowTrail retexture[/url]﻿.


[size=5][b]Config[/b]
[/size]
You can customize this mod by editing the config file or using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url].

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].

﻿﻿If you want to complain or ask for help or help me test my mods, you can visit [url=https://discord.gg/bs6zHuj]my Discord server﻿[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
